image_description: A rectangular, vertical hanging sign mounted on a rough-hewn stone wall. The sign features a red background with a central heraldic emblem consisting of three white ostrich feathers emerging from a gold crown, above a blue ribbon with text 'EST 1901'. Below the emblem is the word 'WADWORTH' in large gold serif letters. The sign is suspended by black metal brackets and topped with a small lighting fixture.
